WITH member_couple AS ( SELECT c.id AS couple_id, CASE WHEN c.inviter_id = #{memberId} THEN c.invitee_id ELSE c.inviter_id END AS partner_member_id FROM couple c WHERE c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId} ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_couple ) AS couple_connected,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM common_survey cs INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.common_survey_id = cs.id WHERE cs.member_id = m.id AND ic.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS has_invitation,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM personal_survey ps WHERE ps.member_id = m.id ) AS personal_survey_completed,
CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_couple ) THEN NULL ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_couple mc INNER JOIN personal_survey partner_ps ON partner_ps.member_id = mc.partner_member_id ) END AS partner_personal_survey_completed
FROM member m WHERE m.id = #{memberId}
